meta.product: ILOSTAT POP XWAP: Working-age population by sex and age; Working-age population by sex and education; Working-age population by sex and rural / urban areas; Working-age population by sex and labour market status; Working-age population by sex and marital status
meta.coverage: Working-age population by sex and age; Working-age population by sex and education; Working-age population by sex and rural / urban areas; Working-age population by sex and labour market status; Working-age population by sex and marital status. LFS - Periodic Labour Force Survey, annual
meta.revisionPolicy: Each ILOEST edition re-estimates the whole modelled history; the raw dump of the previous edition is archived under data/raw/vintages. Survey series change when the ILO reprocesses the unit data.
meta.note: Computed by the ILO from PLFS unit-level data on calendar years (quarters from July 2017), current weekly status. Not MoSPI's published PLFS figures, which use July-June years and the usual status. Observations flagged U are ones the ILO itself marks unreliable.
